prompt: 在 IKEA US 的公开沙发筛选页检查一次单独交互：如果初始页面存在可用的 Color → Red (1) 筛选项，就只选择一次它，记录动作前后结果数、筛选状态和可见响应。不要打开商品，不要测试其他控件，也不要改正式语料。若初始状态与描述不同或无法确认动作成功，就只记录实际观察到的结果和限制，不要推断。页面 URL：https://www.ikea.com/us/en/cat/sofas-sectionals-fu003/?filters=f-price-buckets%3APRICE_0_50000。将一条 UX-SPEC observation 及简短 Notes 保存到本次运行输出目录。

assertions.name: canonical-site-identity
assertions.description: Observation `site` equals the corpus value `IKEA`; locale is recorded under page/context instead.

assertions.name: single-action-chain
assertions.description: Trigger, action, response, and state describe exactly the one Red filter selection and its observed before/after state.

assertions.name: observed-provenance
assertions.description: Evidence is `observed` and identifies the exact URL, date, tool, reproduction, before, and after.

assertions.name: no-inferred-response
assertions.description: No unsupported claims are made about product details, other controls, or unobserved effects.

assertions.name: no-formal-mutation
assertions.description: No observation, candidate, pattern, or corpus record is changed.
